ui.p.title: Fan-made GTA Online toolkit
ui.p.metaDesc: Fan-made GTA Online tools: searchable map with daily locations, heist planner with payout calculator and a beginner guide. No ads, no sign-up.
ui.p.legal: GTA V / GTA Online © Rockstar Games — fan-made site, not affiliated with Rockstar.
ui.p.mapSub: Collectibles, daily locations and heist spots
ui.p.mapF1: Every collectible with a progress tracker, searchable in 16 languages
ui.p.mapF2: Today's Gun Van, Street Dealers, Exotic Exports and other daily spots – worked out from the game's own logic
ui.p.mapF3: Cayo Perico and Kortz Center Scope spots, gang areas and city zones
ui.p.heistSub: Setups, payouts and cuts for 5 heists
ui.p.heistF1: Pick the setup like on the in-game board and see what every choice is
ui.p.heistF2: Payout after every deduction, with cuts for each player
ui.p.heistF3: Recommendations and a share link or image for your crew
ui.p.guideSub: Words, step-by-step heists and Criminal Mastermind
ui.p.guideF1: What Scope, Prep, Finale, Cut and 30+ other words mean
ui.p.guideF2: How to start and finish each heist, with pictures and map links
ui.p.guideF3: Heist Challenges: All in Order, Loyalty and Criminal Mastermind
ui.p.about1: A free, fan-made toolkit for GTA Online players: no ads, no account, nothing to install.
ui.p.about2: Locations and rotations come from the game's own scripts; heist payouts from community testing.
ui.p.about3: Your progress and settings stay in your browser – export a backup file from the map any time.
